#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> a[i];
    
    int first_half = n / 2 + n % 2;
    int second_half = n / 2;
    
    vector<long long> b;
    // First half subsets
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << first_half); ++i) {
        long long t = 0;
        int k = i;
        for (int j = 0; j < 20; ++j) {
            if (k & 1) t += a[j];
            k >>= 1;
        }
        b.push_back(t % m);
    }
    sort(b.begin(), b.end());
    
    long long otv = 0;
    // Second half subsets
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << second_half); ++i) {
        long long t = 0;
        int k = i;
        for (int j = 0; j < 20; ++j) {
            if (k & 1) t += a[first_half + j];
            k >>= 1;
        }
        t %= m;
        
        // Find index of first element >= m - t - 1
        int idx = lower_bound(b.begin(), b.end(), m - t - 1) - b.begin();
        long long t2;
        if (idx < (int)b.size()) {
            t2 = b[idx];
            if (t2 > m - t - 1) {
                if (idx - 1 >= 0) t2 = b[idx - 1];
            }
        } else {
            t2 = b.back();
        }
        otv = max(otv, (t + t2) % m);
        otv = max(otv, (t + b.back()) % m);
    }
    cout << otv % m << endl;
    return 0;
}
